_comment: Structured data for mechanics that 5etools only describes in prose. Each patch merges `set` (5etools field format) into every raw record whose fields equal `match`. `_grants` takes compendium grants verbatim. The importer warns about patches that match nothing.

match.name: Favored Enemy and Natural Explorer improvements

body.P: Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check that uses your proficiency with a tool.
When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.
When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.
Spells you cast ignore resistance to acid damage, and you treat any 1 on a acid damage die as a 2.
Spells you cast ignore resistance to cold damage, and you treat any 1 on a cold damage die as a 2.
Spells you cast ignore resistance to fire damage, and you treat any 1 on a fire damage die as a 2.
Spells you cast ignore resistance to lightning damage, and you treat any 1 on a lightning damage die as a 2.
Spells you cast ignore resistance to thunder damage, and you treat any 1 on a thunder damage die as a 2.
